title: RepositoryMessage
description:
Schema union for the additive standalone repository contracts. Native framing
identifies its endpoint before decoding these payloads, as with `api::WireMessage`.

ConnectionRoute.description:
Discovery reference resolved through an authenticated transport adapter.

This carries neither credentials nor a cloud-specific tunnel/relay type.

protocol.description: Adapter protocol identifier, negotiated by consumers.

reference.description: Opaque, non-secret lookup reference; not a bearer capability.

ContributorId.description: Actual human or service contributor; distinct from a session or host owner.

ContributorIdentity.description:
Attribution resolved by an authenticated adapter, not proof of authentication.

A receiving authority MUST verify these fields against the authenticated
connection. Forwarders preserve the contributor instead of substituting the
session owner, host owner or relay's service identity.

authenticated_as.description: Verified identity used for this submission; no token material.

contributor_id.description: Contributor to whom this request is attributed.

ControlCommand.description: Atomic ownership mutations; all are retried with the original request key.

oneOf.description: Acquire only if no unexpired lease exists and the watermark still matches.

expected_epoch.description: Last observed epoch; a successful acquisition assigns a strictly greater one.

lease_duration_ms.description: Requested positive lease duration, bounded by provider policy.

oneOf.description: Extend the current unexpired lease without changing its epoch.

fence.description: Exact current ownership; stale holders cannot renew.

lease_duration_ms.description: Requested positive extension, bounded by provider policy.

oneOf.description: Release only the matching current owner; retain the epoch high watermark.

ControlEpoch.description: Monotonic fencing epoch; zero means ownership has never been assigned.

ControlFence.description:
Fencing identity carried on every Control action and Control state write.

Not a bearer credential. Authorities must authenticate the holder and validate
current ownership at execution/append time, including on open connections.

epoch.description: Current ownership epoch, greater than zero.

ControlHolder.description: Exact runtime authorized to act as the workspace's Control runtime.

ControlLease.description: Authority-issued lease; renewal retains its epoch, reacquisition increases it.

expires_at.description: Authority-clock exclusive validity boundary; expiry alone grants no successor.

ControlOwnership.description: Durable ownership state, retaining the high watermark even while unassigned.

last_epoch.description: Never decreases or resets on release, restart or coordination adoption.

lease.description: At most one current lease, whose epoch equals `last_epoch`.

workspace_id.description: Workspace scope of both the watermark and any lease.

RecoveryCursor.description:
Recovery position in a workspace, audience and stream generation.

Positions are ordered only inside the same scope. A provider change, retention
reset or visibility change may require a new stream generation and snapshot.
Timestamps are not cursors. Event positions may contain gaps after filtering.

contributor_id.description: Authenticated audience; a cursor is not transferable to another contributor.

position.description: Exclusive resume position: ask for events strictly after this position.

stream_id.description: Authority-issued generation of this audience's visibility scope.

workspace_id.description: Workspace whose retained events are addressed.

Repository.description: Repository metadata; a repository may be attached to multiple workspaces.

id.description: Stable repository identity, independent of checkout paths.

remote.description: Credential-free canonical Git locator, if published.

cursor.description: Position in this audience's current visibility generation.

RepositoryId.description: Repository identity, reusable across workspace attachments.

RepositoryRecovery.description: Bounded recovery result. A reset always requires a fresh authorized snapshot.

oneOf.description: Ordered notifications after the supplied exclusive cursor.

events.description: Strictly increasing changes in one visibility generation.

oneOf.description: The generation changed or the retained history no longer covers the cursor.

RepositorySnapshot.description: Authenticated replacement snapshot with independent configuration revisions.

agent_rules.description: Absent only when this document has never existed.

control.description: Controller ownership, always requiring live revalidation.

grants.description: Current and revoked grants visible to this audience.

hosts.description: Only hosts visible through ownership or grants.

providers.description: Only providers visible through ownership or grants.

sessions.description: Only sessions visible to this audience.

settings.description: Absent only when this document has never existed.

workspace.description: Immutable workspace/chain binding and repository metadata.

Request.description:
Request envelope shared by standalone adapters, managed adapters and Evo.

Mutations with the same key and semantic content replay the original durable
result. Changed content under that key is an idempotency conflict. Queries use
the key for correlation but may observe newer state when repeated.

context.description: Authenticated attribution, retry identity and first-receipt deadline.

control_fence.description:
Required for side effects originating from Control, including state writes.
This is validated against current ownership, not merely deserialized.

RequestContext.description: Request correlation and attribution, unchanged across retries and forwarding.

contributor.description: Authenticated contributor, independent of resource ownership.

expires_at.description:
Deadline for first coordination receipt, using the authority's clock.
Receipt before this deadline permits later runtime delivery and execution.

request_id.description: Caller-generated identity created before the first submission.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to which all payload references are bound.

RequestId.description: Caller-generated retry identity; reuse only for the same logical request.

RequestKey.description:
Complete deduplication key, shared by coordination and runtime adapters.

A key covers all mutation kinds, not just one endpoint. Changing the payload,
deadline or authenticated subject under an existing key is a conflict.

request_id.description: Stable identity of the logical mutation, retained on every retry.

Response.description: Response envelope; correlation never implies that execution succeeded.

result.description: Explicit success payload or protocol failure.

RetryAdvice.description: How to recover from failure without creating a second logical mutation.

oneOf.description: This request must not be resubmitted automatically.
Retry unchanged, retaining the original key and deadline.

not_before.description: Earliest authority-clock retry time, if supplied.

oneOf.description: Outcome is uncertain; reconcile by the original key before taking action.

Revision.description: Metadata revision assigned by the coordination authority.

Role.description: Workspace metadata role; no role implicitly grants compute or model use.

oneOf.description: Workspace owner, subject to the provider's ownership policy.
Membership and configuration administrator.
Workspace participant.
Read-only workspace observer.

RuntimeBinding.description: Current routing binding; moving the runtime does not create a new session.

runtime_id.description: Runtime authorized to report this session's input state.

RuntimeId.description: Runtime instance identity authenticated by its host adapter.

Session.description: Directory metadata; registration is not runtime creation or execution success.

id.description: Reconnectable identity, preserved across coordination adoption.

owner.description: Owner who may share the session, never substituted for an input author.

parent.description: Optional parent session, preserving subagent relationships.

SessionId.description: Reconnectable session identity, preserved across provider changes.

SessionKind.description: Session purpose, independent of ownership and individual contributors.

oneOf.description: Ordinary human-directed or autonomous runner.
Ambient Control session; execution also requires current ownership fencing.

SessionPermission.description: Permission within an existing session; none permit host file/process access.

oneOf.description: Observe the authorized session's runtime history and state.
Submit attributed input to the runtime.
Manage session participation, subject to workspace policy.

StreamId.description: Recovery stream generation, changed after resets or visibility changes.

Timestamp.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch; clocks do not define event/input ordering.

ViewDefinition.description: Saved view definition; derived results still come from history/controller APIs.

json.description: Complete JSON object containing filters/layout; unknown fields survive.

Workspace.description:
One workspace binds to exactly one logical chain.

Changing coordination mode preserves workspace, chain, repository and session
identities. The engine receives only `chain`, never this metadata object.

id.description: Workspace identity; must match the request/event scope.

WorkspaceId.description: Stable logical workspace identity, preserved when adopting managed coordination.

WriteCondition.description: Required precondition for a metadata write; there is no blind overwrite.

oneOf.description: Create only if the entity has never existed in this scope.
Replace only the stated current revision.
